description: This file defines the WorkWeekController class for the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, handling the pre-render logic to set up a Vue component for managing work week configurations in the HR management system.

classes.name: WorkWeekController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the work week UI component, extending AbstractVueController and utilizing traits for service management and internationalization.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with work week day types, translating labels for internationalization.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for permission or capability checks related to work week.
